## Rank7IdentityCasting5 — full source conference completed

```text
COMPLETE_SCOPED_PROPOSED_RANK7_IDENTITY_CASTING5_AUTHORING_WITH_DECLARED_EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES
```

**The return contains five complete proposed procedures, dispositions for all 24 questions, and 10 complete worked encounters with 39 independent branches.** Eleven branches retain explicitly identified external prerequisites.

All five identities remain **tier C**. This is **new, expressly scoped authorship**, not byte-identical acceptance of the source-only packet and not a claim of independent local acceptance or implementation.

**Nothing was applied.** The supplied baseline remains **525 reviewed / 323 pending / 249 standalone / 173 interfaces**, with 39 accepted-but-unapplied identities before any independent Rank8 disposition.

## 1. All requested source files are available

The original conference archive matches **4,534,073 bytes** and the supplied SHA256. All **72 archive members** pass safe-name, uniqueness and CRC checks. All **68 complete source bindings** match their exact bytes and hashes.

The original candidate remains exactly **829,217 bytes**, SHA256:

```text
bdfba569485e0100dadda7ef41b36eb54d810bc2966b547c680836ac1c236766
```

The review preserves and compares **six native placements, 25 actual class-access rows, 11 complete reviewed counterparts and 53 scoped interface references**. The complete DI7 evidence remains intact: **14 original narrative dispositions, the 49-base-expectation data, all 93 final case dispositions and the actual verdict/scope addendum**.

Ten complete later context files are included unchanged and bound to their actual prior archives. Control13 supplies its substantive procedures; Control14 changes the copied-feat Ready reference, not those procedures. Companion05, Illusion13 and preparation-only `COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02` remain separate authorities within their actual scopes.

**Rank8Damage6 was not imported as authority.** Its local semantic disposition remains separate.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="4"}[Complete source authority and precedence](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Rank7_Identity_Casting_5_Part5_Conference_Return_01/SOURCE_AUTHORITY.json)

## 2. The five complete proposed procedures

All five retain **rank 7, 17 RP base cost, Action casting, 120-foot range and V/S/F components**. Actual acquisition remains distinct: Bard and Mirrorsage acquire these at class level **19**; Cleric, Mage and Wizard at **13**.

Cast Echo, Meta Surge, Erase from Reality and Sequester retain Universal access. Simulacrum retains **Illusion for Bard/Mirrorsage/Wizard and Universal for Cleric/Mage**.

### Cast Echo: broader than Fate Echo, with explicit payment and timing

**Cast Echo can repeat damaging spells, creations and actual spell ranks 0–9.** It does not silently inherit Fate Echo’s nondamaging, rank-seven or Action/Bonus-Action eligibility limits.

The selected event rule is expressly new: the caster must have personally perceived and identified the original within 120 feet at its actual casting. It must have resolved, with an inclusive **18-elapsed-second** freshness window. A miss or successful recipient save still counts as resolution; a countered, aborted or still-held original does not. An original Ready uses its preparation timestamp.

The repeat uses **two sequential paid commitments**: the 17 RP Cast Echo commitment and the actual child spell’s commitment. Child obligations are forecast and reserved, then revalidated and repriced after the outer commitment. Fresh targets, native geometry, rolls and source-owned damage roots apply. Donor optional metamagic, class engines and prepared-matrix protection are not copied.

The timing categories are explicitly handled:

- **Action/Bonus Action child:** the expressly selected composite Action.
- **Long casting:** full native work remains. The positive Continual Flame branch takes its actual **600 seconds**, with a newly specified child-work concentration obligation.
- **Reaction child:** the actual native checkpoint remains necessary. A **new Cast-Echo-only held-release bridge** permits the composite at that checkpoint using one real Reaction. **Ordinary Ready remains trigger-first.**

A genuinely spell-tagged class card is not excluded merely because it is a class card. Its independent entitlement and recharge must actually exist. The examples therefore distinguish **ordinary Counterspell, rank 3/5 RP**, from the actually acquired **Wizard class mode, rank 1/3 RP/recharge 2**. A matching name is not permission to choose the cheaper mode.

The procedure also explicitly selects a finite restriction on “any”: no copy-descended original or executable recursive copying, storage or further-casting-access chain. That restriction is labelled **new local authorship**, not a pre-existing universal rule. Missing child adapters remain implementation gaps, not an arbitrary eligibility whitelist.

### Meta Surge: precise waivers, not free spellcasting

The selected procedure affects **one willing creature, including self, for 60 elapsed seconds without concentration**.

It waives the expense and availability of two specifically identified metamagic resources:

**The Mage’s one-per-long-rest Metaspell charge** and **Metamagic Adept’s one-point charge**, including when that particular charge is exhausted. Their ledgers remain untouched: no refill, conversion, refund or banked charge is created.

Actual acquisition, chosen mode, provider eligibility and the one-mode-per-cast restriction remain. Parent spell RP, additional RP, Dissonance, HP, materials, components, Action, concentration and unrelated uses are **not** waived. Resonance Surge’s 2 RP is not reclassified as metamagic.

Qualification occurs at the actual modified-spell commitment. A valid Ready preparation locks its modifier and waiver; later Surge expiry does not create a second charge or retroactively remove the committed modifier.

### Erase from Reality: untargetable, not absent or invulnerable

The proposed spell permits willing acceptance or an expressly new **CHA save**. Its protection lasts until the caster’s **next future regular START**, with a specified six-second endpoint when established outside an initiative sequence.

It blocks new individual creature selections, including beneficial and self-targeted selections. It does **not** remove the real body, gear, collision, support, existing effects or exposure to actual untargeted areas.

The memory promise is completed as a **bounded reversible mask**: other perceiving minds within 120 feet of the recipient, with actual line of effect at admission, lose access to old episodic and recognition links identifying that recipient. It does not delete skills, languages, ownership, written records or global history. Later entrants are not automatically enrolled, and new learning remains possible.

Ending the mask restores access only to memories that still exist. It does not undo a separate, genuine Disrupt Memory deletion or overwrite experiences learned afterward.

### Sequester: real suspension with an explicit clock boundary

The proposed procedure requires an **actually informed, willing creature** and a mutually declared **finite future wake deadline**. It adds no arbitrary universal duration cap, but an omitted deadline does not become an indefinite hostile prison.

It is a continuing **nonconcentration** suspension. Actual whole-Action-denial history and Incapacitated/suspension immunity still apply; willingness does not bypass them. Failed suspension does not leave free invisibility.

The same body becomes **Incapacitated, Speed 0 and Invisible**, with its continuously held original gear. Existing concentration ends. It is not additionally declared Unconscious, Prone or dead.

Only enumerated biological counters pause: aging, breathing consumption, hunger/thirst, metabolism and biological incubation. **World time, spell deadlines, scheduled saves, damage, healing, rule-based recharge, death and Stable clocks continue.** Suspension gives no rest, work or study credit.

Wake routes include the agreed deadline, a bounded ordinary-sense trigger, creator dismissal, a helper’s real touch Action and positive post-defense/pre-temporary-HP damage after its packet. Full suspension suppression wakes permanently; invisibility-only suppression can affect only that component.

### Simulacrum: a usable creature with explicit resource and custody limits

The selected derivative has the donor’s **complete current intrinsic profile**, actual HP and maximum, injuries, native actions, repertoire and accessible memories. It is not a harmless image or an imported half-HP template.

For self-copying, the snapshot occurs **after payment**. External temporary HP, ongoing grants, concentration, pending casts/Ready holds, summoned assets and unique permissions do not duplicate.

A persistent account keyed by **actual creator and donor** preserves derivative resources and history across replacement bodies. Recasting cannot refill RP, charges or ammunition; erase debt/cooldowns; or reset last-spell/Refrain history. An active body can earn actual source-qualified recovery through real time, safety, supplies and recovery budgets. An absent or ended account cannot.

Functional mundane replica gear remains nontransferable and counts its real weight/Load. The explicitly selected projectile exception preserves a genuine native ranged or thrown attack through resolution, then removes the spent prop without refund or recoverable material. Real borrowed items retain their identities and drop locally on absence or ending.

Agency is a **new owner-attached companion selection**: one live body per creator, prospective paid Bonus Action commands within 60 feet, actual shared command/offense limits, one available native Action **or** native Bonus Action behavior, source-qualified movement and its own eligible Reaction. This is not a second free full character turn.

The body is persistent and nonconcentration. Full creating-source suppression preserves the same absent body and account; return requires actual local fit. Ordinary zeroing damage ends it, while the explicitly extended actual Null rule can leave that same body NullDisabled. A living zero-HP template produces no live replacement under the declared finite-body creation rule; it does not heal, kill or resurrect the donor.

No soul, afterlife or cosmology identity is assigned.

Each entry preserves its **complete original unselected question**, the selected answer, actual source references and its new-authoring boundary.

## 4. Ten complete positive worked encounters

| Case | Principal result |
|---|---|
| **RIC5-01-A — Cast Echo / damaging spell** | Observed Fireball is repeated with fresh targets and dice. Outer 17 + child 5 leaves **26 RP/Dissonance 1**. Fresh 28 damage leaves the new target **52 HP**; the echoing caster’s actual self-save leaves **66 HP**. |
| **RIC5-01-B — Cast Echo / Reaction child** | The new scoped held checkpoint permits actual ordinary Counterspell: **26 RP/Dissonance 1**, one Reaction spent, enemy Fireball countered. The separate acquired class-mode branch instead ends at **28 RP/recharge 2**. |
| **RIC5-02-A — Meta Surge / exhausted Reach** | The actual exhausted Mage Reach mode applies twice without refilling its ledger. Rays deal **6 + 5**, target **80→69 HP**. Repeat Dissonance later decays at a real idle END; exhausted free Reach is unavailable after Surge expires. |
| **RIC5-02-B — Meta Surge / Sculpt** | Metamagic use is waived, but Fireball still costs **5 RP**. Mage and ally take zero; foe takes **28**. The separate Resonance Surge branch still pays its extra **2 RP** and resolves the actual Wound save for its 40-damage event. |
| **RIC5-03-A — Erase / direct versus area** | New direct beneficial Invisibility is unavailable against the protected target. Actual area Fireball still deals **28**, leaving **52 HP**. Erase expiry does not undo that damage. |
| **RIC5-03-B — Erase / independent memory change** | Genuine Disrupt Memory deletes a recent episode while older recognition is masked. Erase ending exposes the surviving old memory, not the separately deleted episode. |
| **RIC5-04-A — Sequester / clocks and waking** | Patient **24→20 HP** from actual Chill Touch, then willingly suspends and loses Detect Magic concentration. Chill’s deadline expires during suspension. A caster with actually paid True Seeing later hits with Ray for **6**, waking the patient at **14 HP** after five paused biological seconds. |
| **RIC5-04-B — Sequester / carrying and deadline** | Real body and gear total **180 lb**, within STR 14’s **210 lb** capacity. Their **7 Load** reaches the burdened threshold, reducing Speed to **20**. The carrier moves 10 feet; the same body wakes at agreed time 20 with **50 HP**, no rest reward. |
| **RIC5-05-A — Simulacrum / useful self-copy** | After payment, the derivative has **52/80 HP and 31 RP**. A future actual owner phase commands Ray for **6**, leaving the foe **74 HP**. No second command/offense is created. |
| **RIC5-05-B — Simulacrum / resource continuity** | Unwilling donor fails actual **Illusion DC 19**. Derivative begins **35 HP/6 RP/Dissonance 4**, spends 1 RP and grants **4 temporary HP** through real Resonance Shield. Dismissal/recast retains **5 RP and derivative history**, not a refill; real borrowed lantern stays local. |

The fixture audit corrected and verified actual acquisition and automatic features: Wizard13’s School Mastery, 12 ranked matrices plus five separate known cantrips, five legal Wizard13 book additions, and only **one** Mage13 rank-seven addition. A Spellbinder does not receive an Elementalist-only automatic feature. Earlier Detect Magic and True Seeing prefixes include their real payments.

The cases contain full actor definitions, initial states, chronological before/after transitions, RNG, geometry, source pointers and final states. Action opportunities and external predicates are disclosed fixtures, not proof of a functioning scheduler.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="8"}[All complete cases and 39 independent branches](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Rank7_Identity_Casting_5_Part5_Conference_Return_01/CASE_DISPOSITIONS.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="9"}[Actual class and automatic-feature accounting](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Rank7_Identity_Casting_5_Part5_Conference_Return_01/ACTOR_FEATURE_ACCOUNTING.json)

## 5. Genuine prerequisites remain explicit

The 11 conditional branches retain their actual missing external inputs. These include a complete authorized rank-nine child payload, Metamagic Adept’s real exact acquisition, particular suppression/Null sources, additional simultaneous applications, blocked-return geometry and active-body rest prerequisites.

**The rank-nine branch does not turn missing implementation into a rank-nine eligibility prohibition.** Likewise, Sequester and Simulacrum’s missing runtime adapters do not replace their positive behavior with rejection-only coverage.

The five independent whole positive-case holds remain:

**IN6-09-A, IN6-09-B, EN5-01-A, EN5-01-B and EN6-03-B.**

No CR2 Undead, companion rating from owner level, donor-rating inheritance or save-proficiency-to-Athletics conversion is supplied.

Full Ready, arbitrary Cast Echo child adapters, its new native-Reaction timing bridge, biological/world-clock separation, derivative resource/custody/phase integration, positive Shaman Step, active next-healing consumption and downstream expiry choice/removal remain implementation work.

The four settled owner choices, prior accepted artifacts and completed Control/Mental Prison review remain unchanged. Creation and the historical Mind Maze mid-resolution premise remain separate.

## 6. Exact reconstruction and verification

The return supplies **27 full-value operations**. Forward reconstruction produces the complete successor; reversing them restores the entire original candidate bytes.

The original native/access objects, questions, counterpart authorities and histories remain exact. New procedures, cases and decisions are additional propose
